items.quote: Wir bitten Sie dringend, den Gesamtbetrag bis Freitag, 11.12.2026 zu begleichen.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: Friday, 11.12.2026. This is a company (not an authority) letter, so no statutory deemed-delivery period applies; the date printed is taken as written. 2026-12-11 falls on a Friday as stated, confirmed not a public holiday in NW. Due date = 2026-12-11. To arrive by then via bank transfer, send by ca. 2026-12-10 allowing for processing time.

warnings: This is the second reminder (2. Mahnung); an earlier reminder from 04.11.2026 is referenced but not provided — check that the underlying invoice and delivery (15.10.2026) match your own records before paying.

The letter threatens to hand the claim to a debt-collection agency (Inkassounternehmen) at the payer's additional cost if payment is not received by the deadline; this is a standard but pressuring tactic in dunning letters.

The IBAN (DE67 3705 0198 0005 5770 00) is a validly formatted German IBAN for Musterbank AG, but a valid IBAN does not confirm the account belongs to the stated seller — compare it against the original order confirmation or invoice before paying, especially since this is a reminder letter.
